Shipping & Delivery Information

Fast, reliable door-to-door delivery with Cash on Delivery to over 100+ cities and rural districts across Pakistan.

Free Shipping

Automatic Free Nationwide Delivery on all orders with a subtotal of Rs. 3,500 or higher.

2-4 Days Timelines

Express dispatch from Karachi and Lahore hubs. 1-2 days for major metros, 2-4 days nationwide.

100% Cash on Delivery

Pay in cash only upon arrival. Courier tracking SMS/WhatsApp provided upon package dispatch.

Estimated Delivery Timelines by Region

Once you complete your order, our verification desk confirms order details. Dispatches occur Monday through Saturday from our Karachi and Lahore warehouses.

Karachi & Lahore Metros1 – 2 Business Days

Dispatched same-day or next morning via express priority couriers.

Islamabad, Rawalpindi & Faisalabad2 – 3 Business Days

Daily direct courier linehauls connecting major Punjab and ICT hubs.

Peshawar, Multan, Sialkot & Gujranwala2 – 4 Business Days

Full door-to-door delivery with SMS status updates.

Quetta, Sukkur & Rest of Pakistan3 – 5 Business Days

Comprehensive nationwide reach through TCS, Leopards, and Trax.

Cash on Delivery Instructions

  • Please keep the exact cash amount ready to avoid courier change delays.
  • You will receive an automated SMS on the morning of delivery indicating rider dispatch.
  • If you are unavailable at your address, you may assign a family member or colleague to receive the parcel on your behalf.
